levels.description_zh: 闪光手雷可用来致盲广大效果范围内的所有目标。
levels.description_en: The flashbang grenade applies blind to all targets within a large area of effect.

levels.description_zh: 爆头击杀敌人可替你队伍成员的弹药条增加 1 发子弹。使用特有武器无效。
levels.description_en: Killing enemies with headshots adds 1 to your groups ammo bar. Except from signature weapons.

levels.description_zh: 爆头击杀敌人可替弹药条增加 2 发子弹。使用特有武器无效。
levels.description_en: Killing enemies with headshots adds 2 to the ammo bar. Except from signature weapons.

levels.description_zh: 策士会侦察并标记敌方目标，让他们出现在特工与其他友军的抬头显示器上。
levels.description_en: The tactician scouts and marks hostile targets, feeding them to the agent and other allies' HUD.

levels.description_zh: 装甲包能够修复 100%，移除状态效果并增加对出血、中毒、和燃烧的抗性，持续 20 秒。
levels.description_en: Armor kits repair 100%, remove status effects and increases resistance to bleed, poison and burn for 20s.

levels.description_zh: 使用步枪和射手步枪时提升 3% 爆头伤害，可造成精准击杀。
levels.description_en: 3% increased headshot damage with Rifles and Marksman Rifles, allows for precision kills.

levels.description_zh: 使用步枪和射手步枪时提升 6% 爆头伤害，可造成精准击杀。
levels.description_en: 6% increased headshot damage with Rifles and Marksman Rifles, allows for precision kills.

levels.description_zh: 使用步枪和射手步枪时提升 9% 爆头伤害，可造成精准击杀。
levels.description_en: 9% increased headshot damage with Rifles and Marksman Rifles, allows for precision kills.

levels.description_zh: 使用步枪和射手步枪时提升 12% 爆头伤害，可造成精准击杀。
levels.description_en: 12% increased headshot damage with Rifles and Marksman Rifles, allows for precision kills.

levels.description_zh: 使用步枪和射手步枪时提升 15% 爆头伤害，可造成精准击杀。
levels.description_en: 15% increased headshot damage with Rifles and Marksman Rifles, allows for precision kills.

levels.description_zh: 提升 5% 武器稳定度，减少后座力，可以更快重新瞄准目标。
levels.description_en: 5% increased weapon stability, reduced recoil and faster reacquisition of targets.

levels.description_zh: 提升 10% 武器稳定度，减少后座力，可以更快重新瞄准目标。
levels.description_en: 10% increased weapon stability, reduced recoil and faster reacquisition of targets.

levels.description_zh: 提升 15% 武器稳定度，减少后座力，可以更快重新瞄准目标。

levels.description_zh: 提升无人机持续时间的改造模块。
levels.description_en: Mod to increase the drone's duration.

levels.description_zh: 提升无人机扫描范围的改造模块。
levels.description_en: Mod to increase the drone's scan range.

levels.description_zh: 比你更接近敌人的所有队员获得 +10% 爆头伤害。
levels.description_en: All group members that are closer to enemies than you get +10% headshot damage.

levels.description_zh: 在掩体屏蔽下获得额外装甲。
levels.description_en: Extra armor gained while in cover.

levels.description_zh: 在掩体屏蔽下 20 秒后，每 10 秒会产生 5 发射手步枪的弹药和 5 发步枪的弹药。
levels.description_en: After 20 seconds in cover, you start generating 5 marksman and 5 rifle ammo, every 10 seconds.

levels.description_zh: 提升 10% 特有武器伤害。特有武器强度会随分阶调校，而此伤害加成是额外的。

levels.description_en: +50% Pulse Resistance

levels.description_zh: 一种 3 连发武器，用于近距离冲突。 当需要快速火力和高机动性时，这是理想的伙伴。
levels.description_en: A 3-round burst fire weapon for hectic close encounters. The ideal companion for when the situation calls for rapid fire and high mobility.
